# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]
[GettyImages-1178

  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

### [ Pharmaceutical & Medical Supplies Distribution Services ][127]

and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

Industries with robust R&D Division at Tarapur, Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation

Industries with robust R&D Division at Tarapur, Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation
(MIDC) in close vicinity to manufacturing locations.

  Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals and also produces Formulations with its wholly-owned subsidiary

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

services.

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.

[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

What makes Aerolase's 650-microsecond technology different from other lasers?

The 650-microsecond pulse duration delivers high-powered energy in an ultra-short burst, allowing
precise targeting of melanin, hemoglobin, and water without excessive thermal damage. This enables
safe treatment across all Fitzpatrick skin types (I-VI), including darker skin tones that risk
hyperpigmentation with longer pulse durations used by traditional lasers.

and patients requiring 4-6 treatments, a single patient can generate $2,400-$3,600 in revenue. The
Neo Elite treats 36+ FDA-approved indications, allowing you to treat multiple indications anywhere
on the body, creating multiple revenue streams from one device investment.

How does Aerolase compare to Cutera, Candela, or Cynosure devices?

pulse technology that emphasizes regenerative aesthetics rather than controlled tissue destruction.

Fitzpatrick skin types (I-VI), while competitors often require multiple devices—Alexandrite for
lighter skin and Nd:YAG for darker skin. While Candela and Cynosure excel at high-volume hair
removal with larger spot sizes (up to 28mm) and faster treatment speeds, and Cutera's Excel V+
dominates vascular-focused treatments with dual wavelengths, Aerolase positions as the innovative
choice for practices seeking a versatile, patient-friendly platform that stimulates natural collagen
production across diverse treatment applications without the consumable costs and complexity of
legacy laser systems.

Is Aerolase FDA-cleared, and for which indications?

Yes, Aerolase devices are FDA-cleared for 36+ indications including acne vulgaris, rosacea,
pseudofolliculitis barbae, melasma, benign pigmented lesions, vascular lesions, wrinkles, scars,
onychomycosis, psoriasis, and verrucae. This broad clearance allows practices to address multiple
patient concerns with a single platform.

Is Aerolase safe for darker skin tones (Fitzpatrick IV-VI)?

Absolutely. Aerolase is specifically designed for safe treatment of all Fitzpatrick skin types

laser treatments on darker skin.

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

[Learn More][36]
[Download The Framework][37]

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to

debilitating diseases.

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

The supplement industry is not regulated by the FDA, meaning it is up to the manufacturer to ensure

been third-party tested for purity, quality, potency, and composition, so you can rest assured that
you're getting the key nutrients your body actually needs.

bioavailable forms for maximum effectiveness. This means that our supplements will be absorbed
faster and more completely to ensure you get more of what you need.

We have specifically sourced and formulated the ingredients in our products to be in their most
bioavailable forms for maximum effectiveness. This means that our supplements will be absorbed
faster and more completely to ensure you get more of what you need.

##### No Gluten, Dairy, Soy, GMOs, Preservatives, Dyes, Or Toxic Ingredients

Unnecessary and harmful ingredients can negatively impact your well-being, potentially leading to
long-term health issues. That’s why we commit to designing supplements with clean, pure ingredients.
You know exactly what you’re paying for—without sneaky ingredients in the mix.

[AMMD supplement bottles ]

Our supplements are premium-grade and designed for optimal recommendations instead of recommended
daily allowances—a practice most other supplements stop at. This is because recommended daily
allowances only meet your minimum requirements and fall short of what you need for optimal health.
If you look at our 100 Billion Probiotic, for example, you will find that it contains double, even
triple the potency of competing probiotics.

At Bora Pharmaceuticals, it is our shared responsibility to execute every drug program reliably on
time, consistently in full.

[ Get in touch today ][54]

## A global pharmaceutical manufacturing partner
* From sites in North America and Asia, Bora delivers reliable, high-quality drug products to 100+
  markets around the globe

Bora Pharmaceuticals is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO)
specializing in formulation development, clinical and commercial cGMP manufacturing, and packaging
of complex oral solid dose, liquid, semi-solid, biologic, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical
products.

From our nine cGMP facilities across three countries, Bora Pharmaceuticals delivers drug products
with unparalleled quality to more than 100 markets around the world. Bora’s teams, technologies, and
facilities work seamlessly together with a shared commitment to supporting partners, minimizing
risk, and helping ensure therapies reach patients worldwide.

## Frequently asked questions

What is CatalystAlert?

CatalystAlert is a biotech catalyst tracking platform with AI-powered predictions that helps
investors monitor PDUFA dates, clinical trial results, FDA decisions, and predict stock price
movements for 1,600+ biotechnology companies.

How much does CatalystAlert cost?

CatalystAlert offers a free tier with a 7-day catalyst calendar view, company search and a
watchlist. Pro is $29.99/mo and unlocks the full calendar horizon plus AI predictions and alerts —
and starts with a 48-hour free trial (card required; cancel anytime before it ends and you are not
charged). Elite tier ($99.99/mo) coming soon with API access.

Where does CatalystAlert get its data?

CatalystAlert aggregates data from official sources including ClinicalTrials.gov, SEC EDGAR filings,
FDA openFDA database, EMA, and company press releases. Our ML models are trained on historical
catalyst outcomes with price data — see our public track record for how they have actually
performed.

What types of biotech catalysts are tracked?

We track PDUFA dates, Phase 1/2/3 clinical trial results, FDA Advisory Committee meetings (AdCom),
NDA/BLA filings, earnings reports, conference presentations, EMA approvals, and other regulatory
events worldwide.

How does CatalystAlert analyze catalysts?

We analyze catalyst characteristics, therapeutic area, clinical phase, FDA designations, historical
patterns, and market conditions to help you understand potential stock price impacts. Our
data-driven approach combines multiple factors for comprehensive catalyst analysis.

on COSENTYX®.

[Learn More][13]

## **Important Safety Information**

Do not use COSENTYX if you have had a severe allergic reaction to secukinumab or any of the other
ingredients in COSENTYX. See the Medication Guide for a complete list of ingredients.

**What is the most important information I should know about COSENTYX?**

COSENTYX is a medicine that affects your immune system. COSENTYX may increase your risk of having
serious side effects such as:

**Infections**

COSENTYX may lower the ability of your immune system to fight infections and may increase your risk
of infections. Some people have had serious infections while taking COSENTYX, including tuberculosis
(TB), and infections caused by bacteria, fungi, or viruses. Some people have died from these
infections.
* Your doctor should check you for TB before starting treatment with COSENTYX.
* If your doctor feels that you are at risk for TB, you may be treated with medicine for TB before
  you begin treatment with COSENTYX and during treatment with COSENTYX.
* Your doctor should watch you closely for signs and symptoms of TB during treatment with COSENTYX.
  **Do not use COSENTYX if you have an active TB infection.**

**Before starting COSENTYX, tell your doctor if you:**
* are being treated for an infection
* have an infection that does not go away or that keeps coming back
* have TB or have been in close contact with someone with TB
* have or have had Hepatitis B
* think you have an infection or have symptoms of an infection such as: fevers, sweats, or chills;
  muscle aches; cough; shortness of breath; blood in your phlegm; weight loss; warm, red, or painful
  skin or sores on your body; diarrhea or stomach pain; burning when you urinate or urinate more
  often than normal

**After starting COSENTYX, call your doctor right away if you have any signs of infection listed
above.** Do not use COSENTYX if you have any signs of infection unless you are instructed to by your
doctor.

**What are the possible side effects of COSENTYX?**

**COSENTYX may cause serious side effects, including: **

**Serious allergic reactions**

Serious allergic reactions can occur. Get emergency medical help right away if you get any of the
following symptoms: feeling faint; swelling of your face, eyelids, lips, mouth, tongue, or throat;
trouble breathing or throat tightness; chest tightness; skin rash or hives (red, itchy bumps).

**If you have a severe allergic reaction, do not give another injection of COSENTYX.**

**Inflammatory bowel disease**

New cases of inflammatory bowel disease or "flare-ups" can happen with COSENTYX and can sometimes be
serious. If you have inflammatory bowel disease (ulcerative colitis or Crohn's disease), tell your
doctor if you have worsening disease symptoms during treatment with COSENTYX or develop new symptoms
of stomach pain or diarrhea.

**Severe skin reactions that look like eczema** can happen during treatment with COSENTYX from days
to months after your first dose and can sometimes lead to hospitalization. Your doctor may
temporarily stop treatment with COSENTYX if you develop severe skin reactions. Tell your doctor if
you get any of the following signs or symptoms: redness or rash; itching; small bumps or patches;
your skin is dry or feels like leather; blisters on the hands or feet that ooze or become crusty or
skin peeling.

**The most common side effects of COSENTYX include:** cold symptoms, diarrhea, and upper respiratory
tract infections.

These are not all of the possible side effects of COSENTYX. Call your doctor for medical advice
about side effects.

**Before using COSENTYX, tell your doctor if you:**
* have any of the conditions or symptoms listed above for infections.
* have inflammatory bowel disease (Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis).
* are allergic to latex. The removable needle cap on the COSENTYX Sensoready® pen and prefilled

* are allergic to latex. The removable needle cap on the COSENTYX Sensoready® pen and prefilled
  syringes (150 mg/mL, 75 mg/0.5 mL) contains latex.
* have recently received or are scheduled to receive an immunization (vaccine). People who take
  COSENTYX **should not** receive live vaccines. Children should be brought up to date with all
  vaccines before starting COSENTYX.
* have any other medical conditions and all the medicines you take, including prescription and
  over‑the‑counter medicines, vitamins, and herbal supplements. Keep a list of your medicines to
  show your healthcare provider and pharmacist when you get a new medicine.
* are pregnant or plan to become pregnant. It is not known if COSENTYX can harm your unborn baby.
  You and your doctor should decide if you will use COSENTYX.
* are breastfeeding or plan to breastfeed. It is not known if COSENTYX passes into your breast milk.

[www.fda.gov/medwatch ↗][14], or call [1-800-FDA-1088][15].

**Please see full **[**Prescribing Information**][16]**, including **[**Medication Guide**][17]**.**

4/26     FA-11661233

## **Indications**

COSENTYX® (secukinumab) is a prescription medicine used to treat:
* adults and children 6 years of age and older with moderate to severe plaque psoriasis (PsO) that
  involves large areas or many areas of the body, and who may benefit from taking injections or
  pills (systemic therapy) or phototherapy (treatment using ultraviolet or UV light alone or with
  systemic therapy)
* adults and children 2 years of age and older with active psoriatic arthritis (PsA)
* adults and children 12 years of age and older with active ankylosing spondylitis (AS)
* adults with active non-radiographic axial spondyloarthritis (nr-axSpA) and objective signs of
  inflammation 
* children 4 years of age and older with active enthesitis-related arthritis (ERA)
* adults and children 12 years of age and older with moderate to severe hidradenitis suppurativa
  (HS)

amend this program without notice. Additional limitations may apply. See complete [Terms &

pediatric patients 6 years and older who are candidates for systemic therapy or phototherapy.

COSENTYX is indicated for the treatment of active psoriatic arthritis (PsA) in adults and pediatric
patients 2 years of age and older.

COSENTYX is indicated for the treatment of active ankylosing spondylitis (AS) in adults and
pediatric patients 12 years of age and older.

COSENTYX is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with active non-radiographic axial
spondyloarthritis (nr-axSpA) with objective signs of inflammation.

COSENTYX is indicated for the treatment of active enthesitis-related arthritis (ERA) in patients 4
years of age and older.

COSENTYX is indicated for the treatment of moderate to severe hidradenitis suppurativa (HS) in
adults and pediatric patients 12 years of age and older.

COSENTYX compared to placebo-treated subjects. A similar increase in risk of infection in subjects

dose-dependent in clinical trials.

some fatal infections have been reported in patients receiving IL-17 inhibitors including COSENTYX.

history of recurrent infection. Instruct patients to seek medical advice if signs or symptoms
suggestive of an infection occur. If a patient develops a serious infection, monitor the patient
closely and discontinue COSENTYX until the infection resolves.

If signs of Hepatitis B virus reactivation occur, consult a hepatitis specialist. COSENTYX is not
recommended for use in patients with active viral hepatitis.

**Pre-treatment Evaluation for Tuberculosis**

Evaluate patients for tuberculosis (TB) infection prior to initiating treatment with COSENTYX. Avoid
administration of COSENTYX to patients with active TB infection. Initiate treatment of latent TB
prior to administering COSENTYX. Consider anti-TB therapy prior to initiation of COSENTYX in
patients with a past history of latent or active TB in whom an adequate course of treatment cannot
be confirmed. Monitor patients closely for signs and symptoms of active TB during and after
treatment.

**Inflammatory Bowel Disease**

Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) exacerbations, in some cases serious and/or leading to
discontinuation of COSENTYX, occurred in COSENTYX treated subjects during clinical trials in PsO,
PsA, AS, nr-axSpA, and HS. In adult subjects with HS, the incidence of IBD was higher in subjects
who received COSENTYX 300 mg every 2 weeks (Ulcerative Colitis [UC] 1 case, EAIR 0.2/100
subject-years; Crohn’s Disease [CD] 1 case, EAIR 0.2/100 subject-years) compared to subjects who
received COSENTYX 300 mg every 4 weeks (IBD 1 case, EAIR 0.2/100 subject-years). In addition, new
onset IBD cases occurred in subjects treated with COSENTYX in clinical trials. In an exploratory
trial in 59 subjects with active Crohn’s disease [COSENTYX is not approved for the treatment of
Crohn’s disease], there were trends toward greater disease activity and increased adverse reactions
in subjects treated with COSENTYX as compared to placebo-treated subjects. 

Exercise caution when prescribing COSENTYX to patients with IBD. Patients treated with COSENTYX
should be monitored for signs and symptoms of IBD.

**Eczematous Eruptions**

In postmarketing reports, cases of severe eczematous eruptions, including atopic dermatitis-like
eruptions, dyshidrotic eczema, and erythroderma, were reported in patients receiving COSENTYX; some
cases resulted in hospitalization. The onset of eczematous eruptions was variable, ranging from days
to months after the first dose of COSENTYX. 

Treatment may need to be discontinued to resolve the eczematous eruption. Some patients were
successfully treated for eczematous eruptions while continuing COSENTYX. 

**Hypersensitivity Reactions**

Serious hypersensitivity reactions including anaphylaxis, angioedema, and urticaria have been
reported in COSENTYX treated subjects in clinical trials and in the post-marketing setting. If an
anaphylactic or other serious allergic reaction occurs, immediately discontinue administration of
COSENTYX and initiate appropriate therapy.

The removable cap of the COSENTYX Sensoready^{®} pen and prefilled syringes (150 mg/mL, 75 mg/0.5
mL) contains natural rubber latex, which may cause a hypersensitivity reaction in latex-sensitive
individuals. The safe use of the COSENTYX Sensoready pen or prefilled syringes (150 mg/mL, 75 mg/0.5
mL) in latex-sensitive individuals has not been studied.

**Immunizations**

Prior to initiating therapy with COSENTYX, consider completion of all age-appropriate immunizations
according to current immunization guidelines. COSENTYX may alter a patient’s immune response to live
vaccines. Avoid use of live vaccines in patients treated with COSENTYX.

**MOST COMMON ADVERSE REACTIONS**

Most common adverse reactions (>1%) are nasopharyngitis, diarrhea, and upper respiratory tract
infection.

## **Indications**

COSENTYX is indicated for the treatment of moderate to severe plaque psoriasis (PsO) in adults and
pediatric patients 6 years and older who are candidates for systemic therapy or phototherapy.

COSENTYX is indicated for the treatment of active psoriatic arthritis (PsA) in adults and pediatric
patients 2 years of age and older.

COSENTYX is indicated for the treatment of active ankylosing spondylitis (AS) in adults and
pediatric patients 12 years of age and older.

COSENTYX is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with active non-radiographic axial
spondyloarthritis (nr-axSpA) with objective signs of inflammation.

COSENTYX is indicated for the treatment of active enthesitis-related arthritis (ERA) in patients 4
years of age and older.

COSENTYX is indicated for the treatment of moderate to severe hidradenitis suppurativa (HS) in
adults and pediatric patients 12 years of age and older.

#### Definitions and references

**Definitions**

IL, interleukin; IV, intravenous; JAS, juvenile ankylosing spondylitis; SC, subcutaneous.

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."

By the time it lands, it's old.

the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

## Mission & Vision

[img]

### Mission

To advance healthcare delivery by ensuring access to safe, effective, and affordable generic
pharmaceuticals through innovation, compliance, and service excellence. Drugzone is committed to
empowering healthcare providers—hospitals, long-term care facilities, specialty clinics, and
veterinary networks—through transparent operations, ethical sourcing, and nationwide reliability.

* Ensuring secure, compliant, and traceable pharmaceutical distribution across all 50 states.
* Maintaining ethical and transparent partnerships with healthcare providers and manufacturers.
* Promoting innovation in logistics, compliance, and digital fulfillment for greater efficiency.
* Upholding regulatory integrity through NABP, FDA, and DSCSA 2025 compliance.
* Creating long-term value by prioritizing patient safety and partner trust.

[img]

### Vision

To be among the nation’s most trusted pharmaceutical distribution companies, defined by integrity,
professionalism, and continuous innovation. Drugzone envisions a future where compliant and
affordable access to quality pharmaceuticals strengthens the entire continuum of care.
* **Our vision aspires to:**
* Lead the U.S. market as a benchmark in generic pharmaceutical distribution.
* Advance technology-driven operations that enhance fulfillment speed and traceability.
* Build sustainable business practices that support healthcare accessibility nationwide.
* Foster a partner-first culture rooted in transparency and responsiveness.
* Continue setting new standards of reliability and trust across human and animal health sectors.

## WHY CHOOSE US

At the nexus of trust and tradition, we are not just your generic pharmaceutical distributors, but
your partners in achieving pharmaceutical excellence.


#### Valuable Industry Experience

Your business deserves expert guidance, and our sales representatives bring unmatched industry
expertise of 30+ years to the table. They manage your account while ensuring you receive tailored
advice and support backed by deep knowledge and understanding of the pharmaceutical distribution
industry.


#### 2000+ SKUs

As seasoned generic pharmaceutical distributors, our vast inventory includes over 2,000 SKUs,
allowing us to supply a comprehensive range of pharmaceutical formulations to support your
pharmacy’s operational requirements. From widely used generics to specialized therapies, our
exhaustive portfolio keeps your shelves stocked and compliant.


#### Vast Distribution Network in 50 States

With our extensive nationwide distribution network and license to operate in all 50 states, we
ensure timely and compliant deliveries, reducing wait times and helping you maintain optimal
inventory levels. Our logistical capabilities mean we are always ready to ship directly to your
establishment.


#### Best Pricing in the Industry

Our commitment to affordability is unwavering. We leverage long-standing manufacturer partnerships
and bulk procurement strength to deliver competitive pricing at scale. Every purchase aligns with
our promise of compliance, reliability, and consistent quality—helping healthcare providers maintain
cost efficiency without compromise.


#### Commitment to Innovation

By investing in advanced technology, Drugzone streamlines ordering, tracking, and compliance.
Healthcare partners—from specialty clinics to hospital chains—benefit from secure, efficient, and
transparent operations. Our integrated ERP and compliance monitoring systems enhance real-time
visibility, inventory accuracy, and traceability throughout the supply chain.


#### Partner-Centric Approach

Long-term relationships drive our success. Drugzone works closely with hospitals, LTC providers, and
specialty networks—listening to their needs and delivering solutions that help them serve their
patients better. Our dedicated account managers provide personalized support, ensuring every partner
experiences responsive communication, consistent supply, and measurable value from our
collaboration.

## Comprehensive Distribution Capabilities

Drugzone combines industry expertise with strong logistics to provide comprehensive generic
distribution services. Each capability is designed to help healthcare and specialty partners
maintain a safe, seamless, and cost-effective supply chain.

### Wholesale& Specialty Distribution

Reliable, nationwide generic pharmaceutical supply for healthcare and specialty care providers
across the U.S. Our consistent processes make us a trusted choice among wholesale pharmaceutical
distributors in the U.S.

### Logistics& Warehousing

State-of-the-art warehouses and a nationwide delivery network ensure secure storage and timely
shipments, reducing inventory gaps for healthcare networks nationwide.

### Provider& Pharmacy Solutions

Tailored support for diverse healthcare partners and specialty distributors to simplify procurement
and maintain an uninterrupted treatment supply.

### Compliance& Quality Assurance

We ensure full adherence to NABP, FDA, and DSCSA 2025 guidelines. Every shipment undergoes stringent
checks to ensure healthcare providers—across human and animal health—receive authentic and traceable
products.

Strategic Manufacturer Partnerships

## Trusted Partnerships, Reliable Supply

Drugzone strengthens its nationwide supply reliability through long-standing partnerships with
leading generic manufacturers. These strategic alliances ensure verified authenticity, stable
pricing, and consistent access to essential medications across multiple therapeutic areas.

[img]

### Direct Sourcing

Direct sourcing from trusted and approved manufacturers ensures product integrity and verified
traceability.

[img]

### 75+ Manufacturer Network

Partnered with 75+ leading generic manufacturers across the U.S. and global markets.

[img]

### Verified Authenticity

Every product undergoes multi-step verification and documentation to confirm authenticity before
distribution.

[img]

## Human & Animal Health

At Drugzone, equal commitment is given to human and animal health, ensuring safe, compliant, and
reliable access to quality pharmaceuticals across the U.S. under NABP, FDA, and DSCSA 2025
standards.

[img]

## Human Health

Drugzone supports healthcare facilities nationwide with access to safe, cost-effective generic
formulations. Each product is stored and distributed following the strictest compliance standards.

[img]

### Comprehensive Product Range

A broad portfolio of quality-assured generic pharmaceuticals designed to support hospitals, LTC
networks, and specialty care facilities.

[img]

### Hospital& Specialty Pharmacy Support

Reliable distribution designed to help hospitals and specialty networks maintain consistent
treatment availability.

[img]

### Regulatory Compliance

Strict adherence to NABP and FDA guidelines, ensuring secure, compliant, and traceable delivery of
human health products.

[Know more][20]

## Animal Health

Drugzone extends its trusted distribution network to veterinary hospitals, clinics, and animal care
providers, ensuring consistent access to essential products.

[img]

### Veterinary Product Lines

Dedicated pharmaceutical solutions designed for veterinarians, clinics, and animal healthcare
facilities.

[img]

### Specialty Formulations

Sutures, oncology formulations, and generic alternatives tailored for animal health practices.

[img]

### Trusted Distribution

Compliant with all state and federal regulations to guarantee authentic, traceable supply for animal
care providers.

[Know more][21]
[img]

## Mission & Vision

[img]

### Mission

To advance healthcare delivery by ensuring access to safe, effective, and affordable generic
pharmaceuticals through innovation, compliance, and service excellence. Drugzone is committed to
empowering healthcare providers—hospitals, long-term care facilities, specialty clinics, and
veterinary networks—through transparent operations, ethical sourcing, and nationwide reliability.
* **Our mission focuses on:**
* Ensuring secure, compliant, and traceable pharmaceutical distribution across all 50 states.
* Maintaining ethical and transparent partnerships with healthcare providers and manufacturers.
* Promoting innovation in logistics, compliance, and digital fulfillment for greater efficiency.
* Upholding regulatory integrity through NABP, FDA, and DSCSA 2025 compliance.
* Creating long-term value by prioritizing patient safety and partner trust.

[img]

### Vision

To be among the nation’s most trusted pharmaceutical distribution companies, defined by integrity,
professionalism, and continuous innovation. Drugzone envisions a future where compliant and
affordable access to quality pharmaceuticals strengthens the entire continuum of care.
* **Our vision aspires to:**
* Lead the U.S. market as a benchmark in generic pharmaceutical distribution.
* Advance technology-driven operations that enhance fulfillment speed and traceability.
* Build sustainable business practices that support healthcare accessibility nationwide.
* Foster a partner-first culture rooted in transparency and responsiveness.
* Continue setting new standards of reliability and trust across human and animal health sectors.

## Licensed in All 50 States

With FDA registration and DSCSA 2025 readiness, our 50-state licensing ensures healthcare providers
across the U.S. receive authentic, safe, and timely pharmaceutical supply.

[img]

## OUR PARTNERS

We work with companies and manufacturers worldwide.

## Frequently Asked Question

### 1. What does Farbe Firma specialize in manufacturing?

We are a specialized pharmaceutical formulation manufacturer focusing on Critical Care Injectables.
Our capabilities include liquid ampoules, sterile vials, Lyophilized (Freeze-Dried) injections, and
lipid emulsions across therapeutic areas like Anaesthesia, Pain Management, and Anti-infectives.


### 2. Are your manufacturing facilities WHO-GMP certified?

Yes, our manufacturing facility in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, is WHO-GMP certified. We adhere strictly to
global pharmacopeial standards (USP/BP/IP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) to ensure the
highest sterility and quality for international markets.


### 3. Do you offer Contract Manufacturing (CMO) and CDMO services?

Yes, we provide comprehensive Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.
We support global pharmaceutical companies with formulation development, private label
manufacturing, and scale-up of sterile injectables under their own brand names.


### 4. Which countries do you currently export to?

Farbe Firma exports to over 30 countries across Latin America, Africa, CIS, Southeast Asia, and the
Middle East. We have a dedicated export department that manages logistics and supply chain
compliance for global partners.


### 5. Do you provide Regulatory Dossiers and registration support?

Absolutely. We support our partners with complete regulatory documentation, including Dossiers
(CTD/ACTD formats), Certificates of Analysis (COA), and Stability Data to facilitate smooth product
registration in your local market.


### 6. How can I request a price quote or product sample?

For bulk inquiries, contract manufacturing proposals, or sample requests, please contact our export
team directly at [director@farbefirma.org][57] or via WhatsApp at +91 932 797 4224.

manufacturing, and global pharmaceutical supply solutions.

## Frequently Asked Question

### 1. What does Farbe Firma specialize in manufacturing?

We are a specialized pharmaceutical formulation manufacturer focusing on Critical Care Injectables.
Our capabilities include liquid ampoules, sterile vials, Lyophilized (Freeze-Dried) injections, and
lipid emulsions across therapeutic areas like Anaesthesia, Pain Management, and Anti-infectives.


### 2. Are your manufacturing facilities WHO-GMP certified?

Yes, our manufacturing facility in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, is WHO-GMP certified. We adhere strictly to
global pharmacopeial standards (USP/BP/IP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) to ensure the
highest sterility and quality for international markets.


### 3. Do you offer Contract Manufacturing (CMO) and CDMO services?

Yes, we provide comprehensive Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.
We support global pharmaceutical companies with formulation development, private label
manufacturing, and scale-up of sterile injectables under their own brand names.


### 4. Which countries do you currently export to?

Farbe Firma exports to over 30 countries across Latin America, Africa, CIS, Southeast Asia, and the
Middle East. We have a dedicated export department that manages logistics and supply chain
compliance for global partners.


### 5. Do you provide Regulatory Dossiers and registration support?

Absolutely. We support our partners with complete regulatory documentation, including Dossiers
(CTD/ACTD formats), Certificates of Analysis (COA), and Stability Data to facilitate smooth product
registration in your local market.


### 6. How can I request a price quote or product sample?

For bulk inquiries, contract manufacturing proposals, or sample requests, please contact our export
team directly at [director@farbefirma.org][57] or via WhatsApp at +91 932 797 4224.

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

Today, We Are

* [icon]
  
  ### Having presence in 65+ countries
* [icon]
  
  ### Backwardly integrated for PAP
* [icon]
  
  ### Forward integration for DC
* [icon]
  
  ### Only Paracetamol Manufacturer with RC Logo (2023)
* [icon]
  
  ### 23% Global Market Share in API Paracetamol
* [icon]
  
  ### 40% Domestic India Market Share in Paracetamol API

## Our Pharmaceutical API Products & Formulations

### Paracetamol API – Multiple Grades for Every Formulation

Paracetamol, being the safest & the most affordable Analgesic & Antipyretic drug, is used for
treating fever, flu, body pain and cold.

### Paracetamol DC Granules – Directly Compressible for Tablet Production

Our DC provides drum-to-feeder compression/encapsulation solutions that are both economically sound
and operationally simple.

### New APIs – Theophylline, Rivaroxaban, Folic Acid & More

Introducing Our Latest API Range from Units 4 & 5

EU GMP Certified, 600 MT/Month

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

# Healthy Life Pharma Private Limited

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is acknowledged world wide at pharma horizon, providing a broad
range of pharmaceutical formulation to cope with the necessity of ailing humanity. With its
headquarter at Mumbai (India), Healthy Life Pharma holds expertise in offering different
formulations that include injection, tablets, capsules, liquid, dry syrups, pre filled syringes,
ointments etc.

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is the flagship company of Shah Group, founded by Mr. Shah in 1976.
An encouraging leader and inspiring personality, Mr. Shah has continuously looked forward to shape
the group companies into huge and dynamic enterprise.

Having three decades of experience, Healthy Life Pharma is a WHO recognized organization, which has
certifications for cGMP and ISO 9001:2000 from UKAS for productive management in developing, quality
control and operations. The firm has operations in Indian and global markets as well, where its
business is spread in more than 30 countries. An innovative global pharmaceutical entity, we are
engaged in continuous R&D activities. For its quality production support, the firm has got approvals
from several regulatory authorities of different countries.

## Formulation & Bulk Drugs

Tablets

Available for variety of applications in different forms such as uncoated, sugar coated, film
coated, chewable and more.

Capsules

Wide range of capsules that are available as antibiotic capsules, pain killer capsules, vitamin
supplements & tonics.

Injectables

Safe and reliable injectables that are
available in both powder and liquid
form.

Dry Syrups & Suspensions

We bring to you highly reliable formulation in the form of dry syrup for effective treatment of
variety of ailments.

Eye Drops & Ear Drops

Highly effective eye and ear drops that provide quick relief. These products are available in
sterilized and safe vials.

External Preparation

Avail from us a variety of external application products including ointments, creams and
antiseptic/disinfectants.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

## At Hetero, our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of
## life-saving medicines across the world.

With unparalleled strengths in pharmaceutical research, manufacturing, and marketing, we are
positioned to serve people regardless of geographies. Our new identity embodies this drive to expand
our reach and capabilities in order to respond with agility to the world’s evolving health needs.
Our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of life-saving
medicines across the world.

## Partnering with MPP to expand access of nirmatrelvir & ritonavir generics for COVID-19 treatment

To ensure significant increase in access to COVID-19 treatments for all people, particularly those
living in the poorest parts of the world.

## India Entry, GTM, M&A and Feasibility, backed by global research.

For global enterprises entering India, and Indian companies expanding across markets and capital.
KAMRIT runs the strategy work alongside the filings. Our sister firm Claight (same directors, same

every recommendation.

1
**India Entry & Feasibility Studies**

operating plan.

2
**GTM Strategy & Channel Architecture**

and regulatory checklist.

3
**M&A, Valuation & Transfer Pricing**

filings.

[Plan your India entry][53] [Read GTM playbook][54]
Why KAMRIT

## India's most trusted compliance partner.

15+ years of expertise. Senior-partner accountability. 100% online tracking. No hidden charges.

01

### Senior partner accountability

Every engagement is owned end to end by a partner. No layered teams, no chasing analysts.

02

### Fixed-fee transparent pricing

Published prices for every service. No surprise invoices. Monthly retainers for ongoing compliance.

03

### 100% online delivery

Track applications, documents, and due dates in one dashboard. File from anywhere in India.

04

### India-wide and global

Headquartered in Delhi and Noida, serving clients across India, plus USA, UK, Singapore, and UAE
setup.

How it works

## From enquiry to filing in four steps.

### Tell us what you need

Share a quick description of your business and the service you need. A KAMRIT expert reviews it
within one business day.

### Document review

We send you a precise document checklist. Your dedicated expert reviews everything before any portal
submission.

### Online filing

We file with MCA, GSTN, Income Tax, IPO, RBI, or the relevant authority and track every
notification.

### Approval & ongoing support

You receive your certificate, PAN, GSTIN, or registration number with full digital backup. We stay
on for ongoing compliance.

## Industry-specific advisory across India.

From e-commerce and SaaS to manufacturing and exports, KAMRIT supports businesses across every
industry domain.

[E-commerce & D2C][56] [SaaS & Technology][57] [Manufacturing][58] [Retail & Consumer Goods][59]

Services][63] [Education & EdTech][64] [Food & Beverage][65] [Exports & Trading][66] [Agriculture &
Agritech][67] [Energy & Renewables][68] [Automotive][69] [Aerospace & Defence][70] [Media &
Entertainment][71] [Consulting & Professional Services][72]
5+ Years of professional service since 2020
12 Practice areas under one accountable team
100+ Indian and global clients served
4 Office locations: Delhi (HQ), Noida, plus partner offices

## Built for businesses that need both filings and strategy

Most businesses in India choose between two kinds of partner. Filing platforms are fast and cheap,
but they will not advise you on a market entry, a transaction, or an audit. Boutique consulting
firms are strong on strategy, but they will not file your GSTR-3B or push your DIR-3 KYC. KAMRIT
does both.

That works because KAMRIT is structured as a financial services LLP with capability across
registration, tax, audit, and corporate compliance, and it operates alongside our sister firm
Claight (same directors, same shareholders) which publishes research, analytics, and procurement
intelligence across nineteen industries. Filings flow into advisory. Advisory flows into filings.
One partner is accountable.

## What that gets you
* **Volume work without the platform cost.** Private Limited Company registration starts at ₹4,899.
  GST returns from ₹699 a month. Trademark filing at ₹4,899. All fixed fee.
* **Strategic work without the Big-Four price.** India entry, feasibility studies, GTM strategy,
  M&A, and transfer pricing engagements led by senior partners.
* **Research at your shoulder.** Claight market intelligence informs our India entry and GTM work,
  used by clients across SaaS, manufacturing, healthcare, and consumer goods.
* **A single calendar across regulators.** ROC, FEMA, RBI, GST, Income Tax, PF, ESI, Shops Act, all
  owned, filed, and reported on monthly.

Frequently asked

## Quick answers from our experts.

What services does KAMRIT offer?

KAMRIT offers the complete India advisory stack. Company registration (Private Limited, LLP, OPC,
Section 8, Producer, Nidhi), GST registration and returns, income tax and TDS, MCA and ROC
compliance, trademark and IP, payroll and labour, audit and assurance, plus India entry, GTM
strategy, M&A advisory, and FEMA / RBI work.

How is KAMRIT different from IndiaFilings or a typical CA firm?

Two ways. First, we run both the filings (like a platform) and the strategic advisory (like a
consulting firm) under one roof, so a Private Limited Company registration can flow into a GTM
strategy and an audited annual return without changing vendors. Second, KAMRIT and our sister firm
Claight share directors and shareholders, which means our India entry, market sizing, and
procurement intelligence work sits on top of the same research feeds Fortune 500 strategy and
procurement teams already use.

How much does company registration cost in India?

KAMRIT registers a Private Limited Company starting at ₹4,899, an LLP starting at ₹3,899, a One
Person Company at ₹3,899, and a Sole Proprietorship at ₹1,899. Pricing is fixed-fee and inclusive of
MCA name approval, MOA and AOA drafting, incorporation, PAN, TAN, and bank account opening
assistance.

How long does GST registration take?

A standard GST registration takes seven to ten working days from document submission, subject to the
GSTN officer's processing time. KAMRIT files within one business day of receiving complete documents
and tracks every notification end to end.
