## Built for businesses that need both filings and strategy

Most businesses in India choose between two kinds of partner. Filing platforms are fast and cheap,
but they will not advise you on a market entry, a transaction, or an audit. Boutique consulting
firms are strong on strategy, but they will not file your GSTR-3B or push your DIR-3 KYC. KAMRIT
does both.

That works because KAMRIT is structured as a financial services LLP with capability across
registration, tax, audit, and corporate compliance, and it operates alongside our sister firm
Claight (same directors, same shareholders) which publishes research, analytics, and procurement
intelligence across nineteen industries. Filings flow into advisory. Advisory flows into filings.
One partner is accountable.

## What that gets you
* **Volume work without the platform cost.** Private Limited Company registration starts at ₹4,899.
  GST returns from ₹699 a month. Trademark filing at ₹4,899. All fixed fee.
* **Strategic work without the Big-Four price.** India entry, feasibility studies, GTM strategy,
  M&A, and transfer pricing engagements led by senior partners.
* **Research at your shoulder.** Claight market intelligence informs our India entry and GTM work,
  used by clients across SaaS, manufacturing, healthcare, and consumer goods.
* **A single calendar across regulators.** ROC, FEMA, RBI, GST, Income Tax, PF, ESI, Shops Act, all
  owned, filed, and reported on monthly.

Frequently asked

## Quick answers from our experts.

What services does KAMRIT offer?

KAMRIT offers the complete India advisory stack. Company registration (Private Limited, LLP, OPC,
Section 8, Producer, Nidhi), GST registration and returns, income tax and TDS, MCA and ROC
compliance, trademark and IP, payroll and labour, audit and assurance, plus India entry, GTM
strategy, M&A advisory, and FEMA / RBI work.

How is KAMRIT different from IndiaFilings or a typical CA firm?

Two ways. First, we run both the filings (like a platform) and the strategic advisory (like a
consulting firm) under one roof, so a Private Limited Company registration can flow into a GTM
strategy and an audited annual return without changing vendors. Second, KAMRIT and our sister firm
Claight share directors and shareholders, which means our India entry, market sizing, and
procurement intelligence work sits on top of the same research feeds Fortune 500 strategy and
procurement teams already use.

How much does company registration cost in India?

KAMRIT registers a Private Limited Company starting at ₹4,899, an LLP starting at ₹3,899, a One
Person Company at ₹3,899, and a Sole Proprietorship at ₹1,899. Pricing is fixed-fee and inclusive of
MCA name approval, MOA and AOA drafting, incorporation, PAN, TAN, and bank account opening
assistance.

How long does GST registration take?

A standard GST registration takes seven to ten working days from document submission, subject to the
GSTN officer's processing time. KAMRIT files within one business day of receiving complete documents
and tracks every notification end to end.

## Services

"To give real service you must add something which cannot be bought or measured with money, and that
is sincerity and integrity."

#### Carrying & Forwarding Agent

As a carrying and forwarding agent receiving the goods from the factories, warehousing these goods,
receiving dispatch orders from the principal, and much more.

#### Consignee Agent

As a consignee agent, the company's name is reflected in the consignee column in the bill of lading
or in other words the “buyer” of the cargo.

#### Mother Warehouse Facility

A mother warehouse is a commercial building for storage of goods. Mother Warehouses are used by
exporters, wholesalers, transport businesses, etc.

#### Distributorship

It’s about getting the right medicines to the right patients at the right time, safely and
efficiently. Primary distributors sustain a complex supply chain.

Are Klinic’s services available in my area?

Yes, Klinic’s telehealth services are available nationwide, so you can receive care no matter where

How does Klinic support weight loss treatments?

Klinic offers personalized weight loss treatment plans that may include medications like GLP-1
agonists (e.g., semaglutide) and emerging options like Retatrutide. Providers assess your health
history, goals, and eligibility before recommending any medication.

What should I do if I need a prescription for Semaglutide or other weight loss medications?

To get a prescription for Semaglutide or other weight loss medications, schedule an online
consultation with one of Klinic’s healthcare providers. After reviewing your medical history and
needs, they will recommend a treatment plan and provide the necessary prescription.

Can Klinic help with non-surgical weight loss options?

Yes, Klinic provides non-surgical weight loss solutions, including prescription medications like
GLP-1 agonists, along with lifestyle and diet recommendations to help you lose weight safely and
effectively.

How quickly can I see results with weight loss treatments from Klinic?

Results vary depending on the treatment and individual factors. However, with medications like
Semaglutide and a customized weight loss plan, many patients begin to see results within a few weeks
to months.

medications like Suboxone and offer counseling sessions to support your recovery.

Can I receive long-term support for opioid addiction through Klinic’s platform?

Yes, Klinic offers ongoing addiction support through virtual consultations, follow-up appointments,
and medication management to help maintain long-term recovery.

Is telehealth addiction treatment as effective as in-person treatment?

Yes, telehealth addiction treatment through Klinic is highly effective. Studies show that online
therapy and medication-assisted treatment (MAT) can be as effective as in-person care, especially
with convenient follow-ups and ongoing support.

Klinic is ideal for individuals looking for accessible, professional healthcare services. Whether

Are Klinic’s services available in my area?

Yes, Klinic’s telehealth services are available nationwide, so you can receive care no matter where
you are. Whether you need addiction treatment, weight loss consultations, or mental health support,
Klinic connects you with licensed professionals who are ready to help, no matter your location.

How does Klinic support weight loss treatments?

Klinic offers personalized weight loss treatment plans that may include medications like GLP-1
agonists (e.g., semaglutide) and emerging options like Retatrutide. Providers assess your health
history, goals, and eligibility before recommending any medication.

What should I do if I need a prescription for Semaglutide or other weight loss medications?

To get a prescription for Semaglutide or other weight loss medications, schedule an online
consultation with one of Klinic’s healthcare providers. After reviewing your medical history and
needs, they will recommend a treatment plan and provide the necessary prescription.

Can Klinic help with non-surgical weight loss options?

Yes, Klinic provides non-surgical weight loss solutions, including prescription medications like
GLP-1 agonists, along with lifestyle and diet recommendations to help you lose weight safely and
effectively.

How quickly can I see results with weight loss treatments from Klinic?

Results vary depending on the treatment and individual factors. However, with medications like
Semaglutide and a customized weight loss plan, many patients begin to see results within a few weeks
to months.

Can I receive addiction treatment through Klinic's platform?

Yes, Klinic offers confidential and professional addiction treatment through telehealth services.
Whether you're seeking Suboxone, addiction therapy, or other recovery solutions, our platform
connects you with qualified healthcare professionals who can provide ongoing support and
prescription for medications from the comfort of your home.

What should I do if I need addiction treatment but can't visit a clinic in person?

If you can't visit a clinic in person, Klinic's telehealth platform allows you to receive addiction
treatment remotely. Our platform connects you with professional providers who can prescribe
medications like Suboxone and offer counseling sessions to support your recovery.

Can I receive long-term support for opioid addiction through Klinic’s platform?

Yes, Klinic offers ongoing addiction support through virtual consultations, follow-up appointments,
and medication management to help maintain long-term recovery.

Is telehealth addiction treatment as effective as in-person treatment?

Yes, telehealth addiction treatment through Klinic is highly effective. Studies show that online
therapy and medication-assisted treatment (MAT) can be as effective as in-person care, especially
with convenient follow-ups and ongoing support.

Does Klinic accept insurance for prescriptions and consultations?

Yes, Klinic accepts hundreds of insurance plans, including Medicare and Medicaid, for both
prescriptions and consultations. You can check with our team to verify if your specific insurance
plan is accepted before scheduling a consultation.

Can I get Suboxone or other addiction medications without insurance?

Yes, Klinic offers addiction treatment, including Suboxone prescriptions, even without insurance.
During your consultation, our healthcare professionals will discuss payment options and provide
affordable treatment solutions to ensure you receive the care you need for recovery.

Can I use my insurance for addiction treatment through Klinic?

Yes, Klinic accepts many insurance plans for addiction treatment services, including Suboxone
prescriptions and therapy. You can verify your coverage with our team to ensure you can access
treatment through your insurance provider.

How can I find out if Klinic accepts my insurance for weight loss or mental health services?

To find out if Klinic accepts your insurance for weight loss or mental health services, simply
contact our team. We accept a wide range of insurance plans, including Medicare and Medicaid, and
our support team will be happy to assist you with coverage inquiries.

The Lam family has helped people recover from conditions the conventional approach often overlooks.
Before this way of practicing had a name, Dr. Michael Lam, M.D. was already using it, pioneering a

with fresh insight and care built for lasting wellness.

#### Functional Medicine

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

contacter pour y rencontrer nos équipes.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

Founded in Brooklyn in 1849, Pfizer has channeled American ambition into generations of
breakthroughs that change patients' lives.

 

[Our History][90]

[Photograph of a woman smiling as a child lifts a toy plane toward the sky.]

#### Pfizer's 2025 Impact Report

Every year, we take stock of the impact our work has on the world, the environment, and people
themselves.

##### [ Internal Medicine ][109]

[ View All Internal Medicine ][110]

We’re developing therapies to treat, slow, or prevent disease progression and improve the quality of
life for patients with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular and kidney diseases. 

[Inflammation and Immunology graphical thumbnail portrait image 3]

##### [ Inflammation & Immunology ][111]

[ View All Inflammation & Immunology ][112]

patients waiting.  

 

We specialize in commercial manufacturing for oral solids, sterile injectables and biologic drug
products. With seamless process optimization, scalable production, rigorous IP protection and
regulatory excellence, giving you confidence at every stage of your journey.  

 

Ready to help you build your lasting legacy.

Dedicated to quality. Powered by Pfizer.

Prestigious legacy. Premium manufacturing.

As a proven pioneer in pharmaceutical manufacturing, our experts specialize in maximizing the impact
of your product and building your legacy. While rigorously protecting your IP with a framework of
robust security programs and protocols.

Your network: extended, exceptional, exclusive.

spent decades developing the signature Pfizer approach, earning an uncompromising reputation for
reliability, quality and regulatory support.

Our promise to patients, because time is life.

Committed to improving patient outcomes through the lightspeed delivery of your life-saving
products.  We work with you to conquer  the challenges of today, seize the opportunities of
tomorrow, and build your lasting legacy.

An award-winning global CMO

Outsourced Pharma and Life Science Leaders CDMO Leadership Award 2024 in all categories for the
eighth consecutive year, based on customer feedback.

 

We were even named category champion in all areas and recognized for exceeding customer expectations
in capabilities, compatibility, quality, reliability and service. 

 

We thank our customers for recognizing our team’s dedication and skills and look forward to
continuing our joint efforts to accelerate drug development and bring medicine to patients faster –
because time is life.

Our global manufacturing network

with over 170 years of experience and hundreds of products to its name. Pfizer invests more than $1B
into manufacturing to continuously improve infrastructure and processes.

 

Our global manufacturing network includes sites across six continents, dedicated to serving
customers around the world. From these facilities, we deliver with genuine empathy and assurance at
every step.

# PharmacyChecker Research

## **Not Made in the USA**

#### The Global Pharmaceutical Supply Chain and Prospects for Safe Drug Importation

Many consumer products clearly state where those products are made. Not so for prescription
medications. Where our drugs are made and where their main ingredients are sourced affects drug
safety, affordability, availability, and even national security — concerns that have come to the
fore as a result of the global pandemic. Yet there is too little transparency and too much
misinformation surrounding the supply chain of the drugs we take. “Not Made in the USA” investigates
and details the country of manufacture and the source country for active pharmaceutical ingredients
among widely used, brand name prescription drugs.

[VIEW OUR LATEST RESEARCH][47]

# PharmacyChecker Research

## **Not Made in the USA**

#### The Global Pharmaceutical Supply Chain and Prospects for Safe Drug Importation

Many consumer products clearly state where those products are made. Not so for prescription
medications. Where our drugs are made and where their main ingredients are sourced affects drug
safety, affordability, availability, and even national security — concerns that have come to the
fore as a result of the global pandemic. Yet there is too little transparency and too much
misinformation surrounding the supply chain of the drugs we take. “Not Made in the USA” investigates
and details the country of manufacture and the source country for active pharmaceutical ingredients
among widely used, brand name prescription drugs.

   facilitate direct negotiations between you and the supplier, empowering you with control and
   transparency throughout the process. Importantly, there are no additional fees, and you finalise
   all deals directly with the suppliers.

## What do our happy customers say about us?

[Stephen Cuthbertson]

Andreas Gerold

General Manager of Stragen Pharma GmbH

“The Pipelinepharma platform is incredibly easy to use, much like leading tech products. It lets us
quickly assess the market by providing detailed information on commercially available CTD dossiers
and finished formulations for our markets. Plus, it ensures direct, quick contact with dossier
owners and manufacturers, acting as a personal assistant for our business development needs.”

[Alona Pleshko]

Alona Pleshko

New Projects Development Manager, JSC Kyiv Vitamin Plant

"Using Pipelinepharma’s Subscription plan has greatly benefited our portfolio expansion. We’ve made
significant progress in securing contracts with several suppliers introduced to us, expanding our
conversations beyond just one product. The user-friendly database and the supportive Pipelinepharma
team enhance the experience, making it highly recommended."

[Stephen Cuthbertson]

Stephen Cuthbertson

CEO of Costapharm

“Pipelinepharma’s responsive and user-friendly platform has greatly streamlined our product sourcing
process and facilitated valuable supplier connections. We are currently in active discussions with
several suppliers and have already established commercial relationships with two companies, with
three more agreements nearing finalization. This clearly demonstrates the platform’s effectiveness
in linking us with viable suppliers. Their excellent customer service and efficient search function
make the entire process easy and effective. We are thrilled with the results and the new business
opportunities that have arisen. We look forward to continuing our partnership with Pipelinepharma,
as they have become an essential part of our product sourcing strategy.”

[Daniel Jesus Dagnino]

Daniel Jesus Dagnino

Biosistemas (Grupo Medico Castro Diaz SC)

“Our partnership with Pipelinepharma resulted in remarkable success. In less than three months, we
formalised a contract with a presented manufacturer for four products and started receiving
shipments promptly. Continued discussions with other introduced manufacturers indicate further
promising collaborations. Highly recommend Subscription plan service for efficient sourcing.”

## Simple Enrollment in 4 Steps

## How It Works.

Getting started is easy and takes minutes. Here’s what happens:

Prescription Hope provides access to **hundreds of FDA-approved** brand-name medications for a set
**$70.00 per month** per medication. There are **no other charges** for the medication. Our patient
advocates manage enrollment, coordination, and ongoing program requirements through patient
assistance programs.

Plus, if one prescription assistance option is unavailable, Prescription Hope keeps looking for
other potential ways to help patients save on their medications.

[Trustpilot][20]

### Account Setup

Create your **secure account**. This will be your medication management portal where you can track
orders and manage your prescriptions.

### Add Your Prescriptions

Tell us which medications you need. We work with over **1,500 FDA-approved brand-name medications**
from 180+ pharmaceutical manufacturers.

### Household Information

Provide basic household information **required by patient assistance programs** to verify
eligibility. This helps us determine which programs you qualify for.

### Payment Information

Add your credit card for identity verification. If approved, you’ll be charged $70 per month for
each medication. **If we cannot help you, you will not be charged.**

[Paperwork and documentation icon]

### Submit Online Enrollment Form

Getting started is **free and easy**! Simply complete the online enrollment form. This process
allows you to create an account for your secure patient portal and provide the information needed
for pre-qualification.

[Customer support verification icon]

### Receive Personalized Welcome Call

An Enrollment Specialist will reach out to you for a **personalized welcome call**. During this
conversation, we’ll discuss the medications we can assist you with, and you will only be charged if
we can help.

[Illustration of a prescription pill bottle]

### We Order Your Medication

Once we receive the **required paperwork** from you and your healthcare provider, your first order
will typically be delivered within 2 to 4 weeks. After that, we will manage your ongoing refills
month after month.

[Delivery route or shipment icon]

### You Receive Your Medication

Medications are delivered directly to your home or healthcare providers office. Our **dedicated
team** manages your account month after month, allowing you to focus on what matters most—your
health.

at [COSENTYXhcp.com/dermatology/novartis-patient-support][20] for details.

## **Important Safety Information**

**CONTRAINDICATIONS**

COSENTYX^{®} (secukinumab) is contraindicated in patients with a previous serious hypersensitivity
reaction to secukinumab or to any of the excipients in COSENTYX. Cases of anaphylaxis and angioedema
have been reported during treatment with COSENTYX. 

**WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS**

**Infections**

COSENTYX may increase the risk of infections. In clinical trials, a higher rate of infections was
observed in COSENTYX treated subjects compared to placebo-treated subjects. In placebo-controlled
clinical trials in subjects with moderate to severe PsO, higher rates of common infections, such as
nasopharyngitis (11.4% versus 8.6%), upper respiratory tract infection (2.5% versus 0.7%) and
mucocutaneous infections with candida (1.2% versus 0.3%) were observed in subjects treated with
COSENTYX compared to placebo-treated subjects. A similar increase in risk of infection in subjects
treated with COSENTYX was seen in placebo-controlled trials in subjects with PsA, AS and nr-axSpA.
The incidence of some types of infections, including fungal infections, appeared to be
dose-dependent in clinical trials. 

In the postmarketing setting, serious bacterial, viral, and fungal opportunistic infections, and
some fatal infections have been reported in patients receiving IL-17 inhibitors including COSENTYX.
Cases of Hepatitis B virus reactivation have been reported.

Exercise caution when considering the use of COSENTYX in patients with a chronic infection or a
history of recurrent infection. Instruct patients to seek medical advice if signs or symptoms
suggestive of an infection occur. If a patient develops a serious infection, monitor the patient
closely and discontinue COSENTYX until the infection resolves.

If signs of Hepatitis B virus reactivation occur, consult a hepatitis specialist. COSENTYX is not
recommended for use in patients with active viral hepatitis.

**Pre-treatment Evaluation for Tuberculosis**

Evaluate patients for tuberculosis (TB) infection prior to initiating treatment with COSENTYX. Avoid
administration of COSENTYX to patients with active TB infection. Initiate treatment of latent TB
prior to administering COSENTYX. Consider anti-TB therapy prior to initiation of COSENTYX in
patients with a past history of latent or active TB in whom an adequate course of treatment cannot
be confirmed. Monitor patients closely for signs and symptoms of active TB during and after
treatment.

**Inflammatory Bowel Disease**

Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) exacerbations, in some cases serious and/or leading to
discontinuation of COSENTYX, occurred in COSENTYX treated subjects during clinical trials in PsO,
PsA, AS, nr-axSpA, and HS. In adult subjects with HS, the incidence of IBD was higher in subjects
who received COSENTYX 300 mg eve

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

exporter of finished dosage forms (FDFs) and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). Our main goal
is to improve patient outcomes while establishing industry-defining standards. We strive to produce
necessary drugs that are affordable, easily available, and effective.

## best Services & Products

Pharmaceutical, a well-known pharmaceutical manufacturer and supplier in India. Customers can choose
from a variety of packaging solutions for their items, and flexible payment alternatives. They
guarantee on-time delivery and keep their prices competitive. Salvavidas Pharmaceutical puts the
needs of its patients first by improving safety, efficacy, convenience, and compliance while
offering reasonably priced goods that benefit both patients and society as a whole.

throughout its development, manufacturing, sale, distribution, etc. We are dedicated to establishing

antibiotics. Salvavidas Pharma, which has a large worldwide presence, focuses on public health as a

record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5
billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

[[EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][22]

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

[Read →][18]
[[EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][19]

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

[Read →][21]
[[EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][22]

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

Our ESG commitment shapes how we develop, manufacture, and deliver active pharmaceutical ingredients

### Sustainable Practices for a Greener Future

We are committed to minimizing our environmental footprint by integrating eco-conscious practices
into our production and supply chain. From investing in energy-efficient technologies to reducing
water usage and chemical waste, we actively pursue greener processes without compromising quality or
compliance.

Governance

### Integrity and Accountability in Action

We maintain rigorous compliance standards, transparent reporting, and ethical business practices
across our global operations. From quality control to cybersecurity, our governance framework
ensures accountability and risk management at every level.

People are at the heart of everything we do, and we collaborate with our partners and communities to
promote health, education, and opportunity. Ethical labor practices, ongoing workforce development,
and a commitment to health equity are key pillars of our social impact strategy.

Environmental, Social, and Governance

## We Create Lasting Solutions
## That Drive Change

Our ESG commitment shapes how we develop, manufacture, and deliver active pharmaceutical ingredients
(APIs) and CDMO services, with a long-term view toward shared value and global well-being.

[Learn More][112]
Environmental

### Sustainable Practices for a Greener Future

We are committed to minimizing our environmental footprint by integrating eco-conscious practices
into our production and supply chain. From investing in energy-efficient technologies to reducing
water usage and chemical waste, we actively pursue greener processes without compromising quality or
compliance.

Governance

### Integrity and Accountability in Action

We maintain rigorous compliance standards, transparent reporting, and ethical business practices
across our global operations. From quality control to cybersecurity, our governance framework
ensures accountability and risk management at every level.

Social

### Empowering Communities and People Wordwide

People are at the heart of everything we do, and we collaborate with our partners and communities to
promote health, education, and opportunity. Ethical labor practices, ongoing workforce development,
and a commitment to health equity are key pillars of our social impact strategy.

# Capsules & Health Ingredients

As a global leader in capsule design, manufacturing and encapsulation technology, we are dedicated
to create customized solutions that help you deliver groundbreaking health products to the market.

Backed by an ecosystem of technological insights, world class manufacturing, scientific expertise
and process excellence, we can support your brand throughout the entire development lifecycle.

#### We are capsule and health ingredients experts

Powered by industry-leading technologies, science-backed ingredients and a rich history in the
pharmaceutical and nutraceutical markets, we are more than just our products. We are capsule
experts, ingredient scientists and manufacturers with a solutions-focused mindset and we have been
helping brands overcome challenges for more than 100 years.

We support brands with a broad range of hard empty capsules for the pharmaceutical and nutraceutical
industries, including clean label and plant-based alternatives, as well as innovative delivery
technologies.

In addition, we offer a range of science-backed specialty health ingredients. Fueled by
consumer-centric data, our ingredients enable brands to disrupt the nutraceutical market with
purposeful products for human and animal nutrition.

From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
